title: The End of the Journey
description: A lone traveler with a backpack stands on a mossy cliff edge holding a wooden sign that reads 'THE END'. In the sky above, a large glowing orb contains four overlapping female profiles in purple, green, pink, and yellow wearing a golden crown, with a small green dragon flying nearby. The fantastical landscape features a purple flower field, a winding river with a stone bridge, and a distant castle with golden domes set against mountains under a starry, swirling sky.
